remarks: Ready to make your own, this cozy ranch style 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit features a generous living room and an adjoining dining area that opens onto a private, covered deck with serene views of the beautifully landscaped "Rolling Ridge" complex-one of Norwalk's premier residential communities. Conveniently located with easy access to I-95, Route 7, and the Merritt Parkway, this home offers both comfort and connectivity. Additional highlights include ample off-street private parking, a large 90' x 80' storage area, and the convenience of an in-unit stackable washer and dryer. Residents can also enjoy exceptional amenities such as an in-ground pool, a scenic natural pond, picnic areas, peaceful walking trails, a fenced dog park, and a paddle tennis court. Heat and hot water are included in the HOA.
